description: Product template derived from the accepted 2D manufactured Poisson calibration (experiments/poisson2d/configs/exp2d_baseline.json, C2 ACCEPTED): every method value below is copied unchanged. New attempts require their own identities, their own sealed claim sets and human approval.

network.initialization: torch default (Kaiming uniform) under init seed

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.schedule: exponential decay lr -> finalLr over steps
optimizer.stopping: fixed step count; no early stopping (protocol L4)

sampling.rule: collocationCount pool indices drawn without replacement by the run's sampling seed; the pool is uniform random interior points of (0,1)^2

seedProtocol.rule: triplet i: init=initBase+i, sample=sampleBase+i, batch=batchBase+i, i in 0..runs-1; registered in seed_ledger.json before the first run. These bases are disjoint from the EXPLORATORY pilot bases (20260800 / 20260810 / 20260820).

reproduction.rule: C_repro PASS requires BOTH the 1D-inherited absolute limit (|median_A - median_B| <= 1e-4) AND the tightened relative limit (|median_A - median_B| <= 0.5 * median_A), plus an identical k/N verdict. The relative limit is the natural tightening of Constitution 10.1's dispersion rule (an IQR above 1.0 * median is excessive within one environment, so a cross-environment median shift above 0.5 * median is excessive too); it is preregistered here because the inherited absolute limit alone is loose at the 2D error scale.

thresholdSources.acceptanceCriteria: AC2D-1..AC2D-9 thresholds and their per-criterion dimension verdict and source are frozen in pinn/governance/poisson2d_contract.py (THRESHOLD_SOURCES) and reproduced in the preregistration PART 10 table. epsilonSpec = the AC2D-1 threshold.
thresholdSources.physics: PH1/PH2 are the 2D forms of the flux and energy identities, normalised by their own exact values (int int f = 8, pi^2/2), thresholds 1e-2 as in 1D; PH3/PH5 positivity and monotonicity tolerances 1e-3; PH4 (swap symmetry) and PH6 (discrete maximum bound) 5e-3 = the AC2D-2 scale; PH7 is an SPD witness with an energy floor. All frozen before any formal training and before the claim pool was sealed.
thresholdSources.signatures: sPdeResidual uses the AC2D-4 threshold on the dev holdout residual; sBcResidual the AC2D-3 threshold; sLocalizedError the 1D symptom ratio 3.0 on an 8x8 tile partition (symptom rule, not an acceptance threshold; the acceptance form of localization is AC2D-9); sConservation the PH1 threshold; sSeedSensitive the Constitution 10.1 rules.
